segments.text: Badge flashes green at 605
Rain on the glass and the lobby alive
I filled this thing, I shipped it clean
But nobody clapped in the weekly machine
My manager says you did the work
Then pauses hard with a practice smirk
The numbers shine but the story's thin

Tell me one influence lie.
Influence means before they measure me out of the team.
Four social gatherings Thursday night.
Tiny name tags under brewery light.
I hold a paper cup, rehearse a laugh, make a network from the better half.
Political snoozing by the catered wall, nodding at titles.
I cannot recall
They call it connection, they call it care
My breathing winds air
I bring a plan to the skip level call
Free shot proposals, risks and all
He says be louder in the room
Like volume alone can make a gun in bloom
I say, whose room, which door, what proof
The silence gathers around the truth
Then somebody says, let's take this offline, and the clock keeps chewing.
Now I know what influence means, a shadow moving behind the scenes.
A handshake held a second too long, a careful smile where a doubt belongs.
But I made the river run on time, and I won't disappear to fit their line.
You can score me, sword me, close the screen
I am all, keep your amber boxes
Keep your chart
I kept the craft and I kept my heart
When the badge goes dark, when the hallway clears
I leave with my name intact this year
You
